newsitem.title: USA: Target said up on acquisition talk.
newsitem.headline: Target said up on acquisition talk.

text.p: Shares in Target Therapeutics Inc rose late Monday on speculation that the company would be acquired, possibly by Boston Scientific Corp, analysts said.
"Both companies are having conference calls today. So that tells you something," said Oppenheimer & Co medical technology analyst John Calcagnini.
Shares in Fremont, Calif.-based Target, a medical devices manufacturer, were up 12-1/4 to 59 before being halted news pending.
Target executives did not return phone calls.
Fahnestock & Co analyst Juan Noble said he suspected Target's shares were up on a possible acquisition, but was uncertain of the acquirer.
"Nothing drives a stock price like this more than an acquisition rumor," Noble said.
Boston Scientific executives could not be reached.
